title: The Irrelevance of Environmental, Social, and Governance Disclosure to Retail Investors
eligible_reason: Not a staggered adoption design. The regressors of interest are firm-day event indicators (esgday = ESG press-release day, rpday_noesg = non-ESG press-release day, eaday = earnings-announcement day) that switch on for single days and off again; they are not an absorbing treatment with unit-specific adoption dates. Models are reghdfe with firm (gvkey) and date (dretdate) FE, return controls (rrawdb25 rrawdb625 or lnmve mb rrawdb26251) and SEs clustered by date.
design_notes: Firm-day panel of Robinhood (Robintrack) user holdings changes, June 2018-Dec 2019. Tables 2-7: reghdfe Y $events1 $controls1 if eaday+esgday+rpday_noesg+nonevtday > 0, absorb(gvkey dretdate) vce(cluster dretdate), with Y in {rawcgc11_ascaled, sopadjcgc11_ascaled, userscgvoldc11_ascaled, absrawcgc11_ascaled, abssopadjcgc11_ascaled, absrvwdc11, share_turnover_3days}; event indicators split by return terciles in later tables. Tables 8-9: reghdfe Y best100day_btrrank ... (Fortune Best Companies list events). 'ft_staggered' flag in the frame is a false positive.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: No staggered binary adoption in the reported designs.

specs.exclusion_reason: event-day indicators switch on and off (no absorbing adoption); return controls
specs.outcome: rawcgc11_ascaled and four other holdings-change measures

data_files: stata-output/*.smcl logs and Table#.xml result files
data_files_note: No analysis data in the package: inputs are Robintrack, RavenPack, CRSP, Compustat, IBES, Truvalue Labs and manually collected CSRWire releases. Only code, logs and exported table XMLs are included.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README PDF read with pdftotext). Firm-day event-study of press-release days; no DiD.
